# A09-S157: Generated members

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

I have also made some - I think quite interesting - collages
of our members. They are generated with a new model called Stable
Diffusion, which I have then asked to create images resembling GANs with the
hashtag #trendingonArtStation, which is the most used hashtag on Twitter
for AI images.

In this way, it is a collage of AI images about how people make
GANs. Although it is obviously not representative in a scientific
sense, it is quite interesting, because it illustrates AI's own idea of
its diversity.

And it is better than I had thought - for example, there are quite a few Asian-looking
people, but also brown ones, and besides that a bird or another animal here and
there.

I was thinking if we could print some cheap posters with them? Then one could
have a white field at the bottom, where one writes "DET SYNTETISKE PARTI -
ARE YOU IN?"

, which will catch both that people are already with (because they potentially are in the
database), but also with a call to participate.

I do not think of it as election posters, but more as cheap "posters", where
each is unique. There are many more where they come from... so smart.

[…]
